question: Why do these alternative paths fail to grant liberation in transmigration?
premises: They do not liberate in transmigration.
They are devoid of the akula hero.
The akula hero is implied as necessary for liberation.
inference: Because they lack the akula hero, these paths do not liberate in transmigration.
uncertainties: akulavīra may refer to a realized adept or to a supreme Kaula principle.
plain_english: They do not liberate in transmigration, being devoid of the akula hero.
